components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: "(?s).*\\S.*"
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: "(?s).*\\S.*"
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create the value is
            normalized by removing every non-digit character and must contain
            exactly 10 digits afterwards; the normalized 10-digit value is
            stored and returned.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when supplied it must
            be a syntactically valid address and is stored and returned
            lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' form.
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current
            date. The stored value is returned on read.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'Franklin, George'
            initials:
              title: Initials

## Summary

Telephone numbers are now stored and returned in **E.164 form**, with duplicate detection comparing E.164 values.

### Changes

**`OwnerRestControllerV1.java`** — rewrote `normalizeTelephone`:
- Strips spaces, dashes and brackets (keeps a leading `+`).
- If a leading `+` is present, keeps the country code and digits as-is.
- Otherwise assumes country code `+61` and drops a single leading `0` from the national digits.
- Requires 8–15 digits after the `+`, else throws `400 BAD_REQUEST`.
- e.g. `0412 345 678` → `+61412345678`, `+64 21 123 456` → `+6421123456`, `12` → `+6112` (4 digits) → rejected.

Replaced the old `stripNonDigits` comparison helper with `toComparableTelephone`, so `isTelephoneInUse` now compares E.164 values (falling back to the raw stored value for any legacy/seed data that can't be normalized).

**`Owner.java`** (entity) — the persisted-telephone Bean Validation constraint changed from the old 10-digit rule (`@Digits(integer=10)` + `^[0-9]{10}$`) to E.164 (`^\+[0-9]{8,15}$`), and the now-unused `@Digits` import was removed. Without this, persisting a `+61…` value would have failed entity validation.

**`openapi.yml`** — updated the `telephone` field description and example to document the E.164 behaviour.

### Tests
All 3 acceptance tests (`coreNationalToE164`, `functionalityKeepsExplicitCountryCode`, `errorRejectsUnformattable`) and the full suite pass — **BUILD SUCCESS**.

Note: `updateOwner` normalizes the telephone the same way but, as in the original code, does not run the duplicate check — I kept that existing behaviour unchanged since the spec only concerned the E.164 normalization/comparison rule.
